body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Datawind announced the launch of 'UbiSurfer', its first netbook during CES Unveiled at CES 2010, offering users free Internet access in the UK and low cost roaming in Europe and USA.
Priced at £159.99 and available from Maplin retail stores and Ideal TV home shopping, the UbiSurfer combines Wi-Fi, LAN and embedded wireless data modem and SIM to make the Internet truly ubiquitous.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
